subject: Post-call: compliance discovery & evidence checklist (SOC2 / audit logs / retention)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pinnaclepay.com>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@pinnaclepay.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: compliance discovery & evidence checklist (SOC2 / audit logs / retention)

Alex / Sarah — great to meet you earlier. Quick recap from our call with PinnaclePay and next steps so we have a single place to track evidence requests and timing. I focused this on the security and data-retention items we discussed.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary pain: need end-to-end auditability for transaction flow (metadata and event-level logs) for at least 3 years; potential regulatory ask for up to 7 years in specific jurisdictions.
- SOC 2: you need Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II and confirmation of scoping (multi-tenant vs isolated environments).
- DPA / contractual: want a DPA redline and confirmation on subprocessor list (esp. any analytics/monitoring partners).
- Pen test evidence: request for pen test summary and remediation timeline + whether redwood will provide remediation attestations.
- Retention & export: need sample audit-log export (schema + sample extract) and confirmation of default retention and admin-driven retention configuration.

What Redwood will provide (committed)
1) SOC2: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (attached) — full Type II report available under NDA, summary attached.
2) Audit log extract: sample-audit-log-extract.json (attached) showing event schema + retention tags.
3) Evidence intake: evidence-intake-template.xlsx (attached) — map artifacts to your control owners to speed the intake.
4) DPA: we will circulate a DPA draft for your legal to review; point person on our side: Marcus Lin (cc).
5) Pen test: summary of most recent external pentest and remediation notes; we will surface remediation attestations for critical findings.

Asks from PinnaclePay (from call) — please confirm:
- Target retention window (3y vs 7y) and whether EU branch requires stricter retention rules.
- Primary security contact for artifact collection and technical deep dive (name + email).
- Whether you want Redwood to propose a scoped private deployment (VPC) or start with Hosted + Dedicated fallback.

Proposed next steps & owners
- Jasmine (me): schedule 30-min technical deep-dive with our SysSec/Engineering (suggest Fri 10/23 or Mon 10/26).
- Marcus (cc): circulate DPA draft and subprocessor list by EOD 10/23.
- Marcus & IR: provide pen test summary + remediation attestations by 10/29.
- Alex/Sarah: confirm retention window and security lead by 10/23.

If that looks right I will create a HubSpot task and a shared Drive folder with the artifacts. Thanks again for the time — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(jasmine.liu@redwood.ai)

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary stub)
- evidence-intake-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@pinnaclepay.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@pinnaclepay.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: compliance discovery & evidence checklist (SOC2 / audit logs / retention)

Thanks Jasmine — very helpful summary. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) Retention: our default for transaction-level audit logs is 5 years, but our EU entity requires 7 years for certain payments reporting. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports per-tenant retention policies or per-region retention controls?

2) Data residency / private deployment: we prefer to evaluate a VPC/Private deployment for production in Q1. For the technical deep-dive, please include an engineer who can speak to network isolation and KMS integration.

3) Tokens / PII: does Redwood persist end-user tokens or other PII-derived identifiers in logs by default? If yes, is there a recommended redaction config?

4) SOC2: we'll need the full report but can sign an NDA if that's required — happy to get that started today.

We can do Fri 10/23 11:00-11:30 PT for the technical deep-dive. Sarah (cc) will be our security lead and will own artifact collection.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Head of Security & Risk, PinnaclePay
alex.chen@pinnaclepay.com

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 3:03 PM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex / Sarah — great to meet you earlier. Quick recap...

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: compliance discovery & evidence checklist (SOC2 / audit logs / retention)

Looping in Marcus to own the DPA and pen-test artifacts. A few internal notes: 

- Retention: Redwood supports per-tenant retention policies via config in the Console; per-region overrides are available for Private deployments. We should confirm whether PinnaclePay will accept Hosted with retention controls or insist on Private for the 7y EU requirement.
- Tokens: by default we store hashed request ids and non-PII metadata in logs. We have an established redaction guide; engineering can show the config during the deep-dive.
- NDA: Marcus can share SOC2 under NDA; recommend sending our standard mutual NDA (drives faster turnaround).

Action items IRENE->JASMINE: I'll prep a short internal checklist for the tech call so the SysSec/infra folks know which artifacts to surface.

Irene Choi
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
